name: DolphinBench bounded workspace repair and verified resume handoff
objective: Repair only reviewed Dolphin harness/export/recovery code and its focused tests/docs. Never launch scored work from the coding sandbox. Run focused tests, retain exact evidence, and give the trusted parent a verified recovery handoff. Unknown actions/charges, true argument mismatches, missing/tampered proofs or scientific changes require escalation. Do not submit nested AtSys tasks.
plan: Coding repair has workspace-write scope only. The parent executes trusted fixed commands for private/MEM writes outside the coding sandbox after review. Ordinary load_condition/admission remains enforced. resumeArgv verifies and writes a command handoff only; it cannot launch providers or apps. Root supplies recovery-request.json after review; missing inputs fail closed. Never change graders, models/settings, memory/retrieval, upstream, fixtures, old results, budget caps, secrets or AtSys control policy. Never silently update hashes or ignore a gate. Do not reset apps, replay uncertain actions, regenerate completed grades or start full600. Bounded2 repairs do not authorize arbitrary code execution or autonomous approval. Read recovery-implementation.md for request schema and escalation rules. This is a template only, not a submitted task.
